title: DECISION: smtp: prefix for dual-backend email ID routing
description: Email IDs that start with 'smtp:' are resolved from the mailbox_messages SQLite table; anything else is parsed as a CID and fetched from IPFS. This clean namespace partition means Email/get and Email/query never need a schema migration or a flag column to know which storage backend to consult — the ID itself carries that information. Alternative rejected: a separate 'source' field in every JMAP response, which would require callers to track it out-of-band and would pollute the JMAP wire format. Tradeoff: CID strings can never start with 'smtp:' (they are base32/base58 encoded), so the prefix is permanently unambiguous.
